## chat-client: message_get takes required &[Id], unlike canonical email_get's Option<&[Id]>
Crates: jmap-chat-client
Evidence: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/message.rs:72 message_get(ids: &[Id], properties: Option<&[&str]>), whose doc at L49 says 'ids is required (non-empty)'. Canonical crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs:58 email_get takes ids: Option<&[Id]>, and so does every other *_get across the client siblings. The chat draft (jmap-chat-spec draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L1190-1192) says only 'Message/get: Standard JMAP /get', so null ids are valid on the wire and the server is the one meant to enforce limits (requestTooLarge).
Why breaking later: Widening &[Id] to Option<&[Id]> changes the public signature, and every call site needs Some(..).
Fix: Take `ids: Option<&[Id]>` like email_get and drop the client-side 'fetch all is disallowed' guard; RFC 8620 maxObjectsInGet / requestTooLarge is the server's job.
Size: S
